messages:
Maya R: Posting profiler dump from this morning's canary. P99 spiked on model `redwood-alpha` after we flipped default to Triton for small batches (<8, seq<=32). Attached are heap of logs and timeline snapshots.

Tom L: saw it. quick summary?

Maya R: TL;DR: Triton gives better throughput for mid/large seqs but for short sequences we're seeing 18-25% higher p99 vs CUTLASS on H100. Regret increased whenever probe decides to switch kernels mid-window.

Anika: do we have kv-cache warmup correlation? i remember seeing higher miss rate during probe windows.

Maya R: yes — KV cold-start requests overlap the probe sampling interval. when KV cache is cold Triton path latency has larger variance because of different memory access pattern.

ben: can you paste the exact probe config that ran?

Maya R: here's the decision snippet we used in canary:
```json
{"probe_sample_rate":0.02,"probe_window_s":300,"seqlen_threshold":48,"batch_threshold":8,"fallback_hysteresis_s":60}
```

Tom L: 2% probe seems fine but combined with short-run burstiness it looks like probes keep toggling the kernel. oscillation -> p99 regression.

Kai: we also saw batch-smearing: a few long tails injected into small-batch queues causing Triton to pick different kernel variants and slow the whole micro-batch.

Anika: possible mitigations: 1) per-model seqlen histogram + set seqlen_threshold to 95th percentile; 2) increase hysteresis or use decay-based sticky score; 3) require KV cache hit rate above X before allowing a kernel switch.

Maya R: proposal: adaptive-probe that computes weighted seqlen distribution for last N requests and only triggers a kernel-swap if the predicted p99 improvement > 5% and kv_hit_rate > 0.6. Also add a short suppression window (2min) after any rollout change.

ben: +1. Also we should make probe sampling stratified by seq bucket not purely random. ensures representative samples for short/long seqs.

Tom L: what about lowering probe_rate but increasing probe_window? That reduces churn but delays discovery. For busy models discovery is quick anyway.

Kai: We Need safe fallback when Triton shows high variance: add a variance penalty term to the kernel score: score = median_latency + alpha * var_latency. Alpha tuned to penalize noisy paths.

Anika: where do we compute these metrics? runtime tenant, central metrics, or both? prefer runtime-local with periodic push to central. avoids pump delays.

Maya R: runtime-local makes decisions faster. we'll emit summary to central so console can surface it.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for branch `adaptive-probe/kvcache-check` (job #4829).

Tom L: for change set we need tests: 1) synthetic seqlen mix (70% short, 30% long) load test, 2) kv cache warm/cold scenarios, 3) oscillation stress test with alternating patterns.

ben: i can write the stress harness. Plan to parametrize seqlen skew and kv miss ratio.

Maya R: logs to capture: kernel_choice, kernel_score breakdown, kv_hit (bool), batch_size, observed_latency (p50/p95/p99), variance. Include per-worker seed for reproducibility.

Kai: also instrument queue composition at sampling moments. We had hidden cases where one worker had 90% short seq and another had 50/50 — global decisions made without that nuance caused problems.

Anika: suggestion: add a worker-affinity override. if a worker's local score strongly prefers CUTLASS, keep it on CUTLASS even if cluster median nudges it otherwise. fall back only when cost > X or manual rollout.

Maya R: Will add affinity TTL = 10m. Also add manual admin knob in console for per-model forced-path to assist debugging.

Tom L: what's the rollback plan if adaptive-probe makes perf worse in canary?

Maya R: infra-bot will trigger rollback if p99 increases >10% for 10m and error rate stable. We also have deploy-bot hook to revert.

infra-bot: Canary watch started for `redwood-alpha` on h100-canary. Threshold: p99 +10% for 10m => rollback.

ben: Implementation notes: kernel_score components: latency_est (from rolling window), variance_est, cost_est (GPU cycles), kv_penalty (function of kv_miss_rate). sample_count minimum 50 to trust.

Anika: on sample_count: use Bayesian shrinkage to avoid noisy early estimates (prior from model family).

Kai: small nit: make sure we don't double-penalize when batch_size small and kv_miss high. both correlate but different causes.

Tom L: final ask: add quick CLI to force a single evaluation probe for a single worker with specified seq distribution. Useful for reproducing.

Maya R: i'll push PR with the probe + telemetry + console knob. tagging design doc in the PR.

Tom L: ack. can we schedule a 30m sync tomorrow after initial canary? want to review telemetry charts live.

Maya R: scheduled 10:30 PT tomorrow. calendar invite sent. :calendar: 

Kai: filed a follow-up issue to refine scoring function and tune alpha. (#ISSUE-1427)

Maya R: thanks everyone. I'll paste the perf dumps and the PR link in this thread once ready.

deploy-bot: rollback executed for job #4811 -> reverted to CUTLASS default on canary (manual rollback triggered).
